reviews.text: He looks like a new dog! The groomer is so patient with him, he’s a worm.

First time at this location, and it was a great experience! Will was super nice and helpful, especially with the store’s services and finding the right dog food for my pup. My dog gets really anxious with grooming, and Omar was incredibly patient, gentle, and kind with him. Thanks Will and Omar!
It’s pricey but they have everything you need and the front desk staff were very helpful
Nice and friendly the guy with all the hair was awesome
Our dog Finn looks great!

Mr.Smitty and I were completely satisfied with his first “fur appointment “ at Doggie Style Pets.  Service was excellent. Estimated time for grooming was spot on. I didn’t have to wait all day to get my baby back.  We will definitely return on a regular basis.
Great job grooming my doodle....Quick, easy, friendly! Job well done! Definitely recommend them.
My dog biscuit got the best looking first haircut ever. They really worked hard on him and made him look really handsome. Would definitely recommend going here for grooming. Liz Trainer
Excellent customer service and my dog loves it!!! ❤️ So happy this store opened in chestnut hill. 🙌 …
So love people who not only understand and work well with furry friends, but also their not so furry human friends.
Nice store. Clean and organized. Good products. Professional staff. My dog loves it there.
Ash did a great job with my dog who is very shy. We will definetly be back.
Ash was great with Betsy during her nail trim! Betsy was nervous but it was quick and painless. Thanks Ash!
Love love, love this store, Staff is great and the store has everything.
Ashley always does a super job. Love the cut she gives Hazel.
Great grooming!
Came for grooming for the first time. The groom itself was superb and quick. The atmosphere was calm and comforting for my pup. Glad to have a reliable groomer close to home.

We love the staff here especially our groomer Ash is lovely! Our pup literally SHAKES her whole body when she sees where we are and can't wait to go in. They have a killer selection of toys and treats always.

Just about every time we go here, the Doggie Style Team is so wonderful, to both the pups (and cats!) and the people! They are so helpful and knowledgeable with the different items that the store offers, as well as local treats and items! We hope to try out the nail trimming services soon as well!
We were very pleased with our first visit today…so pleased we have scheduled another nail clipping in February.   Happy you are nearby.  Thank you for fitting us in with no appt.

Everyone at Doggy Style Chestnut Hill is so friendly and professional. Deb is outstanding and Ashley did an A+ plus job on grooming my Zoe!! The store is very clean neat organized has everything and more that I need and Zoe has never looked better. Thank you.!!
5* All the way.  My doodle is a rescue and as such has many quirks. I have taken him elsewhere and they were not able to do a good job. The groomer there was fab and reasonable!
Very knowledgeable and helpful staff.   Glad this store is in the area.
Nice friendly place and great place to shop for my son dogs. Also, nice to meet Ace and Leen, two dogs waiting for adoption.

Today was my first time coming, it was a great experience. Deb was awesome. I came from going to Weavers Way pet store on Carpenter Lane. I had a bad experience there and will never go back. Doggie Style Pets is officially our new store. I wish I would've known about it before. Very welcoming and pleasant experience. Highly recommend!

The clerk was very pleasant. They did not have one of the the brands I was looking for, and as an animal rescue non-profit, I’m not required to pay sales tax on our supplies, but the clerk did not know how to    Do a tax-exempt transaction.
Went here for grooming services for the first time.  The staff was welcoming and friendly and the service was quick and efficient.
Both of our white goldens had their first grooming and clipping in September and we were quite pleased with their new marshmallow clean and well groomed fur.

A really great grooming. The instructions I left were followed or exceeded. I asked that all burrs be taken from my dog's long coat. Miraculously that was done. I did not talk about the tree sap down at the skin level but somehow that was removed too. And the grooming took around 90 minutes. Overall, this was a much better experience than I had had at PetSmart.
The staff is so friendly! My dog drags me to this spot after the park. You can rescue pups in need here, get grooming services, or just stop by for a doggie treat.

I was so surprised they were open on a holiday Monday, I popped in and poke to the lovely customer care rep who was so helpful!

She was kind, informative and generous. We explained some difficulties we were having with our new kitten and the rep tuned right in and told us all about our breed, and gave us some helpful tips and tricks on how to resolve our issues. And, she was SO right! We researched more and discovered exactly what was going on. This one conversation has changed our entire experience with our cat for the better. We are so grateful and can’t thank your team enough! She also gave us some fun food samples, which our cat LOVES! We’re so grateful you’re in the neighborhood and will be back! Thank you so much!
Love having this place so close to my house! The staff and especially Ash are so good!
Outstanding shop with friendly knowledgeable staff and great groomers.

My wife and I stopped by the other day and we had an amazing experience at this facility, all thanks to Wanda, the manager. From the moment we arrived, she was incredibly welcoming. Wanda took the time to introduce us to the adorable furry friends who are up for adoption, and it was clear how much care and love they receive. She went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and had a wonderful time meeting each of the animals. We truly appreciated her kindness and attention to detail. Although they are stray ins and many times the staff doesn’t quite know what breed the dogs are, Wanda googled a few she thought may fit the furry friends description for us. If you're looking to adopt or just meet some amazing pets, I highly recommend visiting!
They took such good care of Douglas! I was nervous going to a new dog groomer but from the start they all were extremely friendly and welcoming! Will be returning for sure!
Awesome store with everything you furry best friends could need.  The staff was amazing and helpful!!!!
